original.reason: The induction reduction is not established. The asserted inequality on coefficients is unjustified, and in Case 2 the claimed new coefficient sum need not be smaller (its difference from the old sum is a3-2a1).

judgment.reason: The remaining p<r and q<r case is only asserted as a “standard” calculation. It neither specifies legal successive operations nor derives a smaller relation norm.
The alleged “standard two-step” decrease is not proved. The fact r<p+q does not by itself show that either stated one-step substitution decreases the l1 norm.
The displayed absolute-value inequality does not imply the asserted strict descent, and the claimed two legal subtractions are not specified or justified.
In the case p<r and q<r, the purported result of applying two subtractions is not derived; legality after the first subtraction and strict reduction of the coefficient norm are both unproved.
